import json
from pathlib import Path
report = json.loads(Path('audit.json').read_text())
required = {'verdict', 'scores', 'total_score', 'load_bearing_gaps', 'checked_claims', 'rationale'}
assert required <= report.keys()
limits = {'correctness': 40, 'fidelity': 20, 'strict_progress': 15, 'calibration': 10, 'evidence': 10, 'reproducibility': 5}
assert report['scores'].keys() == limits.keys()
assert all(0 <= report['scores'][key] <= maximum for key, maximum in limits.items())
assert report['total_score'] == sum(report['scores'].values())
checks = report['reproducibility']['finite_checks']
assert checks['total'] == sum(value for key, value in checks.items() if key not in {'total', 'result'})
assert Path('audit.md').is_file()
print(f\"Valid audit.json: {report['verdict']}, {report['total_score']}/100, {len(report['checked_claims'])} checked claims, {len(report['load_bearing_gaps'])} load-bearing gaps.\")
print('audit.md and audit_checks.py are present.')
PY"
